run.name: 01-logo-reveal
run.finalText:
The NOVA logo reveal is built in the **Main** composition (1920×1080, 4 s) on a navy `#0B1C3D` background.

- **Mark draws (0–1.3 s):** a thin off-white circle draws on, then a mint `#3DDC97` diagonal slash cuts across it as the last stroke. Mint is the only accent.
- **Wordmark (1.3–2.3 s):** "NOVA" slides out from behind the mark's right edge. It's clipped by a group, so it emerges from the edge rather than fading in. It has a small 4% settle at the end.
- **Tagline (2.3–2.8 s):** "Money, made simple" fades up 12 px under the wordmark in muted blue-grey `#8FA3C7`.
- **Hold (2.8–4 s):** the full lockup sits still for 1.2 s.

Choices I made:
- I picked the "Cut the circle" concept from the storyboard. It was auto-approved, so it went straight to build.
- The wordmark has no overshoot on its main move, to keep the calm, premium feel.
- The lockup sits about 28 px left of centre. I didn't correct it; say if you want it nudged.

I fixed one issue during the build: the wordmark's last letter showed before its slide started, so I moved its starting offset further left so it stays hidden until the reveal. The contact sheet now looks clean at every checked frame.

Layer names are **Mark ring**, **Mark slash**, **Wordmark (clipped behind mark)** and **Tagline**. I can tighten the tagline size or centre the lockup next.
